description: Suggested grapheneX preset sketch for a ClearPath VPS/Docker host. Import/adapt into grapheneX modules.json after verifying each module name with `list` in your installed grapheneX version. Apply step-by-step — do not blind-run on production.

presets.name: ClearPath_Host_Baseline
notes: Prefer running modules individually in the grapheneX UI first.
Confirm SSH + reverse proxy (80/443) + ClearPath PORT still work after Firewall changes.
Skip any module that disables SSH or blocks your admin IP.
recommended_manual_order: Firewall last — keep SSH + 80/443 (+ localhost app port)
